items.title: XLM parity and threat model
items.blockedReason: XRC source supports XLM/USD and defaults to a received-rate floor of 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM quote/quorum is unknown. The read-only connector refused the backend for lack of a service-discoverability manifest; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called.
items.nextAction: Verify connected-wallet CreateAccount support and establish an authorized read-only path for the XRC XLM/USD live quote/quorum; validate SDF, Tatum, Blockdaemon, or Ankr endpoints when DNS access is available and resolve provider selection.

items.title: Stellar rail and independent vectors
items.nextAction: Run focused Cargo tests/build after 5964c17c when the shared slot is available; verify provider fanout and signed bounds, then resolve XLM key/network/provider binding and oracle/reserve freshness.

items.title: Stable state and XLM launch guard
items.nextAction: Cargo-verify the emergency freeze/pause, canonical operation IDs, signed amount/ledger bounds, and credit helpers; keep receipt/tombstone state dormant until integrated into a complete deposit-credit flow.

items.title: Verified deposits and borrowing
items.blockedReason: No XLM deposit/borrow endpoint or live credit lifecycle exists. New fallback routes fail closed at source level, but Cargo tests/build have not rerun after commit 3e12fba5; claim/intent state remains dormant.
items.nextAction: Implement provider/key/network binding and deposit credit/receipt/tombstone lifecycle after the source-only helpers and guards are validated; preserve WP3 blocked until end-to-end evidence exists.

items.title: Claims, exits, and liquidation handling
items.blockedReason: No supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Unsupported routes fail closed in source, but the current guards have not been Cargo-tested; claim/intent state is dormant and Frozen config keeps XLM unreachable.
items.nextAction: Implement and validate XLM claim settlement and supported payout lifecycle; preserve WP4 blocked until settlement and testnet evidence exists.

items.title: User flows, Candid, and monitoring
items.nextAction: Implement supported XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, and claim flows with explicit pending and unresolved states; keep them unavailable until route and integration safety is resolved.

items.title: Tests, independent review, and testnet
items.nextAction: Run focused validation after 5964c17c when the shared slot is available; then complete testnet, frontend integration, reserve/oracle checks, and release review. Keep the XRP post-sign status race as a separate reuse caution, not an XLM gate.

items.title: Release, configuration, and activation evidence
items.blockedReason: The implementation and required review, CI, artifact, audit, operational, and current network evidence are not complete; XRC XLM/USD live quorum is unproven.
items.nextAction: Complete key/network/provider binding, current reserve/oracle checks, claim settlement, testnet, frontend, and release prerequisites while registration remains frozen.
